# &lt;stdint.h&gt;

Source: [`src/libc/include/stdint.h`](https://github.com/lassedtu/ginnOS/blob/main/src/libc/include/stdint.h)

integer types of fixed width. the types are the compiler's own
       (\_\_INT64\_TYPE\_\_ and so on), so they agree with it on both
       architectures: int64\_t is long long on i686 and long on x86\_64.
